run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T05:48:32Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is explained by a configuration/deployment gap rather than by Prometheus being unhealthy: the alerting rule that fired is the stock kube-prometheus rule max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 (for: 10m), i.e. it reports that this Prometheus discovers zero Alertmanagers. Consistent with that, the cluster contains no Alertmanager component at all: the complete Deployment listing (36 objects) and StatefulSet listing (6 objects) contain no Alertmanager workload, and namespace prometheus has exactly five Services and five Endpoints (operator, prometheus, kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated, node-exporter) with none for an Alertmanager, and no namespace named monitoring/alertmanager exists. The Prometheus instance itself is up and being served: the Endpoints of Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus carry 100.96.5.74:9090, the instance in the alert. The Prometheus pod was recreated at 2026-11-17T05:48:00Z, 32s before the alert startsAt, but its StatefulSet is at generation 1 with currentRevision = updateRevision = prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59 (identical to the pod's controller-revision-hash), so no pod-template change occurred and the restart is a mechanism, not the cause of the missing Alertmanager; the alert's firing time coincides with the first rule evaluation after that restart. What I could not verify: the Prometheus CR (kind Prometheus, monitoring.coreos.com) and its generated config secret are not readable, so whether spec.alerting still selects an Alertmanager Service that does not exist, or whether Alertmanager was deliberately disabled at install time, remains a hypothesis; the driving metric prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered is not present in the metrics backend reachable here (its job values are only kube-state-metrics, kubelet, otel-collector), and pod logs were empty. No entity in the otel-demo application was observed failing in this investigation; application-level error/latency signals were not examined because the alert concerns the Prometheus alert-notification path.

claims.text: The alert definition PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers in the Prometheus rulefiles ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 evaluates max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 with for: 10m and severity: warning, so it fires only when this Prometheus discovers fewer than one Alertmanager.

No Alertmanager workload exists in the cluster: the Deployment listing returned all 36 Deployments (clickhouse-operator, ingress-nginx, kube-system, metrics-server, opentelemetry collectors/operator, 22 otel-demo app Deployments, prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-state-metrics) and the StatefulSet listing returned all 6 StatefulSets (chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder, topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus); none is an Alertmanager.

Namespace prometheus contains exactly five Services — prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (443), prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (9090 http-web, 8080 reloader-web), prometheus-kube-state-metrics (8080), prometheus-operated (9090), prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter (9100) — and its matching Endpoints objects are the same five; there is no Service or Endpoints object for an Alertmanager in that namespace.

The Endpoints of Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus contain address 100.96.5.74:9090 backed by pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, which is exactly the instance in the alert, so the alerting Prometheus itself is running and being served.

The cluster has 15 namespaces (agent, clickhouse, clickhouse-operator, data-recorders, default, ingress-nginx, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, metrics-server, opensearch, opentelemetry-collectors, opentelemetry-operator, otel-demo, prometheus); no namespace named monitoring or alertmanager exists.

Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 was created at 2026-11-17T05:48:00Z (32 seconds before the alert startsAt), runs image quay.io/prometheus/prometheus:v3.6.0 with config-reloader v0.85.0, has restartCount 0 with no previous container instance, and is Running with both containers ready.

StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus is at metadata.generation 1 with observedGeneration 1, currentRevision = updateRevision = prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59 — the same controller-revision-hash carried by the pod — so the 05:48:00Z pod recreation did not follow a pod-template change.

The Prometheus rulefiles ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 was created at 2026-11-17T05:41:38Z and carries the rule files, including prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml which holds the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule.

The metrics backend reachable in this run exposes only three job label values in the query window — kube-state-metrics, kubelet, otel-collector — so the self-scrape job prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus that the alerting rule selects is not among the series this investigation could query.

The observer side of this alert exists in-cluster as StatefulSet prometheus-alert-recorder in namespace data-recorders (created 2026-11-17T05:55:52Z, pod prometheus-alert-recorder-0 Running, restartCount 0).

Most likely explanation: the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has an alerting configuration whose Alertmanager target no longer resolves — the kube-prometheus-stack Alertmanager component (workload plus its prometheus-kube-prometheus-alertmanager / alertmanager-operated Services) is absent from this cluster, so Kubernetes service discovery yields zero Alertmanager targets and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays below 1. The Prometheus CR and its generated config secret could not be read, so this remains unverified.

Alternative explanation with the same observable: this kube-prometheus-stack installation was deployed with the Alertmanager component intentionally disabled (no Alertmanager workload or Service was ever created), so the stock PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule fires as an inherent property of the deployment rather than because something broke at 05:48Z.

The pod recreation at 2026-11-17T05:48:00Z is temporally adjacent to the alert's startsAt (05:48:32Z) because the restarted Prometheus re-evaluated the rule immediately after startup; it did not create the zero-Alertmanager condition, which is a property of the (unchanged, generation-1) StatefulSet template and of the absent Alertmanager component.

Rejected: that Prometheus itself was down, crash-looping or unreachable, which would make the alert a scrape artefact. Pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running with both containers ready and restartCount 0, and Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus has a healthy endpoint at 100.96.5.74:9090, the instance named in the alert.

Rejected: that a network policy or a Service/Endpoints selector mismatch between Prometheus and an existing Alertmanager is breaking the connection. There is no Alertmanager Service or Endpoints to select (the five endpoints in namespace prometheus are operator, prometheus, kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated and node-exporter), so the failure is absence of a target, not blocked or mis-selected connectivity.

Read the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (monitoring.coreos.com) spec.alerting.alertmanagers and the generated config secret prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus to confirm whether it still selects the kube-prometheus Alertmanager (e.g. Service prometheus-kube-prometheus-alertmanager on port web) or whether alerting is unset; that decides between the two remaining hypotheses.

If alert notification is wanted, deploy the Alertmanager component (Alertmanager object plus its operator-managed StatefulSet and Service) and point spec.alerting at it; if it is not wanted, disable the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule or the alertmanager.enabled value so the warning is not generated for a deliberately absent component.

gaps: The Prometheus object (kind Prometheus, monitoring.coreos.com) and the generated config secret prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus are not readable with the available tools, so whether spec.alerting.alertmanagers is set and to which Service could not be verified. No change-history integration is available (data_sources.not_integrated: change_history), so when or whether an Alertmanager was removed cannot be established.

The metric the alert is computed from, prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered, could not be queried: metric-name and instant queries for prometheus_.* / alertmanager.* returned nothing, and the reachable store exposes only job values kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector, so the value 0 behind the alert is inferred from the alert definition and cluster topology, not read directly.

Pod logs for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and prometheus-alert-recorder-0 returned zero bytes (all streams status read/unavailable), so startup messages, config-reload errors and alertmanager connection errors could not be inspected, and the previous container instance does not exist (no restart).

Kubernetes events for this window cover only 2026-11-17T05:55:52Z to 06:28:38Z and contain no event for namespace prometheus or for the pod recreation at 05:48:00Z, so why the pod was recreated (manual delete, eviction, node event or controller action) is unknown; events before 05:55:52Z are not available.

No NetworkPolicy objects were returned by a cluster-wide listing (status no_data), which cannot be cited as proof that none exist; connectivity blocking was rejected only because there is no Alertmanager target at all.

It is unknown through which path the alert reached Alertmanager/this investigation, given that no Alertmanager runs in the cluster; the in-cluster prometheus-alert-recorder StatefulSet in data-recorders is a plausible recorder, but its logs were empty.

Application-level health of the otel-demo services (their own error-rate or latency signals) was not examined: the alert concerns the Prometheus alert-notification path, so no claim of application impact or application health is made.
next_steps: Fetch and inspect the Prometheus CR prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus spec.alerting.alertmanagers and its generated config secret (a human with secret read rights) to confirm which Alertmanager Service, if any, is configured.

Check the kube-prometheus-stack Helm values / release configuration to determine whether alertmanager.enabled was set to false, and review whether an Alertmanager object or StatefulSet previously existed (e.g. from etcd backups or audit logs; change history is not integrated in this run).

    for: 15m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1

A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

query.jq_expr: .items[] | select(.metadata.name=="prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0") | .data | to_entries[] | select(.value|test("PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers")) | .value | split("\n") as $l | ($l|length) as $n | [range(0;$n) | select($l[.] | test("alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers"))] as $idx | [$idx[] as $i | range($i;($i+16)) | select(.<$n) | $l[.]] | join("\n")

content:
- alert: PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
  - alert: PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} has detected {{$value
